made_from: PDB entry 1GRL (examples/data/molecules/1grl.pdb, a GroEL subunit): the vertices of the isosurface at 12 of its heavy atoms' blur map (cvc::mol::blur, blobbiness -0.3, a 2 Å grid; cvc::iso, DUALLIB), each coordinate rounded to a multiple of 1/64 Å (so its decimal is exact). secondary_structures_test's The1GRLInputIsItsBlurMapsIsosurface makes it again (libcvc master d04c070d, transfix/libcvc#1428's blur); make_inputs.py leaves this case as it is.
